title: Text Volume Chapter 624 Happy
content:
Text Volume Chapter 624 Happy

Hancheng Nvlu was opened by Daojian, a merchant from Jiaodong. This Daojian was originally from a humble background. The family had been doing business for generations and dealt with Qi State's sword coins, so they took Dao as their surname. Nowadays, the world uses five baht coins, but it does not affect it at all. His desire for profit. After the establishment of the Haidong Trading Company, all the other merchants were selling leather goods and medicinal materials. Only Dao Jian found a new way and brought several boats of prostitutes over to comfort the loneliness of thousands of Qin soldiers and earn all their rewards at the same time.

The expenses here are not cheap. Every soldier has to weigh his wallet when he comes in.

Liu Ji doesn't care about money. In his words: "If you have life to earn, but not to spend, wouldn't it be a loss?"

So in September of the 34th year of Qin Shihuang, the army wiped out the remaining members of Canghaijun. After returning to Hancheng, the first thing Liu Ji did was to plunge into the female house.

This is not the first time for Lao Liu to come here. When he first arrived here a few months ago, he ran here frequently.

The price of nvlu is also divided into three, six or nine grades. The cheapest ones are women from Sanhan and Dongyi. They are short in stature, have rough hands and feet, don't like to be clean, and can't speak a word of Xia Yan. Liu Ji asked, these Women are either slaves of various tribes and are given to caravans by the emperor in exchange for goods from the Central Plains, or they are deceived by Dao Jian using various methods...

The little spare money in the pockets of ordinary soldiers was only enough to find these barbarian women, and there was no exchange of words during the whole process.

The slightly more expensive one is that Todojian transports women from Qi. Many military officials come here not only to solve physical problems. Life here is boring, and they only deal with big soldiers every day, so the military officials like to talk to these women. , business always starts with small talk and ends with farewell. Many officers have become repeat customers.

After all, Liu Ji was a small military official, so he didn't have to line up with the soldiers outside the simple small tent on the periphery. He asked the slaves in the sword room to take him to pick a girl with ease!

Liu Ji's requirements are not high. It is best to be younger. Of course, the more beautiful the better.

The one chosen by Liu Ji was a slender woman who, judging by her age, was old enough to be his daughter. She had eyes like a doe, but a generous smile on her face, and she said "general" to Liu Ji.

After she approached Liu Ji, she touched Old Liu's crotch very knowingly, with a surprised expression and seductive eyes. Liu Ji returned the favor with a smile.

Then, he discovered that she was naked under the skirt of her coarse cloth shirt. It seemed that she had just been washed, maybe she had just received other guests.

Liu Ji didn't care. This kind of dewy feeling was all about warmth. He touched it again, tsk, even though he was thin, his chest was a little heavy.

He was very satisfied and sent the slaves in the knife room away. A man and a woman entered the tent and got down to business immediately. The woman's high voice soon joined the chorus of the female servants.

Liu Ji was only three years younger than Qin Shihuang, but his body was as strong as ever, and it took him half an hour to finish.

By this time, the two of them had become very familiar with each other, and through chatting they learned that the girl's name was Juan Er, named after a common wild vegetable. She came from Donghai County, which belongs to the Chu region of Sishui County, and their languages are similar.

"Looking at the general's age, his children should be older than mine, right?"

It's rare to meet a fellow countryman, Curl Er said as she leaned on Liu Ji's shoulder. She just found a white beard in Liu Ji's beard and volunteered to pull it out for him. The pain made Old Liu scream.

"Childless."

Liu Ji's hands were dishonestly touching Juan'er's body, and he still had unfinished thoughts. Apparently, he had forgotten about Liu Fei, his illegitimate son with Widow Cao.

"Have you ever gotten married?"

Juan Er's eyes lit up. She also heard that the war was over. It was not an option to keep doing this job. She wanted to find an honest man to marry, but her love was unreliable. The younger military officials had to go back to get married. The older ones She also has a wife and children, so she can only hope to find an old bachelor with no children.

Liu Ji smiled: "I got married three years ago, and my wife is about the same age as you."

"I have been married for three years and still have no children. Could it be that General..."

Although Juan Er was disappointed, he stared at Liu Jizhong's lower body and chuckled. This meant that Liu Jizhong didn't see any use for it.

"Nai Gong had a son with the widow next door ten years ago. How can he be sick?"

Liu Ji was a little annoyed. Only then did he remember that he "seemed" to have an illegitimate child in his hometown, and then bragged that he had arrived in Jiaodong just after getting married. Because he was "highly used" by the superiors, he never had the chance to go back.

He boasted loudly, but in his heart he cursed.

"If it hadn't been for that black man, I wouldn't have left my delicate wife at home and come to this barbarian land to sleep with this prostitute."

"So the general hasn't returned for three years?"

Curly Er chuckled and joked: "General, aren't you afraid that your little wife has been staying in an empty house for three years and couldn't bear it anymore and found another man?"

When the prostitute said this, Liu Ji suddenly murmured in his heart, and he really felt that the top of his head was a little green.

Lv Zhi looks like a Zhou Zheng and is the eldest daughter of a wealthy family. Before she even passes the door, there is a long queue of suitors from Pei County! Even Pei County Magistrate's son coveted her and tried to marry her several times but failed.

Can such a woman survive being left alone at home?

But then I thought about it, Lu Gong was a famous person, and he had promised a beautiful daughter to him inexplicably, but Sina left her the day after the wedding and never returned. Maybe Lu Pheasant had remarried.

"It doesn't matter, just think that she and I are also having an affair."

Liu Ji quickly put this incident behind him. His life was in the hands of the black husband. He didn't know when he would be crushed to death. How could he have the time to care about others? It's better to have fun in time.

It was still early before dark to check the camp, and just when Liu Ji was about to take advantage of the heat to make another attack, the voice of the servant in the sword room sounded outside.

"Liu Baichang, your soldiers are coming to find you!"

"What's the hurry! Let him wait for a moment!"

Liu Ji did not intend to stop, and kept moving, and the laughter and laughter continued until a weak voice sounded outside...

"Baichang, it's Commander Wei who has come to Hancheng. He sent a messenger to the camp and asked to see you by name!"

Juan Er found that Liu Ji, who was extremely vigorous on the couch, suddenly withered at this moment...

…

"Young man Liu Ji, please pay homage to your Majesty!"

As soon as Liu Ji entered the camp, he bowed to the ground.

"It's Liu Ji."

Heifu had just finished his meeting with Fusu and was working out the itinerary and date for the return of the army with Cao Cao and Cao Shen. When Liu Ji came in, he showed a smile.

"I haven't seen you for a few months. I heard that Liu Ji, you have made great achievements in Lintun. Beheading Ying Lun is enough to get a promotion."

Liu Ji acted very low-key: "It was the Junjun who gave Liu Ji the opportunity to go into battle and kill thieves. Whether he is promoted or demoted depends on the Junjun."

"I came to you because I have something to ask you."

Hei Fu nodded to Cao Shen: "Cao Bingpu, it's up to you to speak."

Cao Shen used to be Liu Ji's boss. He admired him a little but also disliked his private behavior. In the past three or four years, the "three heroes" in Peixian County have been in different situations. Cao Shen has done the best and has been recommended by Hei Fu as a soldier to take charge of the Jiaodong County soldiers.

Xiao He was the next best. Although he had some grudges at first, he was outstanding in ability and gradually gained the respect of the black man. He also became a Cang Cao and was in charge of the money and food of a county.

Compared with these two people who were entrusted with important tasks, Liu Ji seemed quite miserable.

But in Cao Shen's view, this was just brothers going up the mountain and working hard together. Liu Ji had killed Heifu's Paoze back then, so it would be good for Heifu to spare his life.

Thinking about it this way, Cao Shen no longer had any psychological burden on what he was going to do next.

He coughed softly and said: "Although our army has broken Lintun, if we abandon it, it will be occupied by Canghaijun's remaining party, Sanhan, and Donghao. Perhaps we can send a group of soldiers to garrison in the field to separate Sanhan and the Hao people. Contact us. But there is still a shortage of five hundred masters over there. After some discussion between the commander and the military commander, they decided that you are the best candidate. Liu Ji, are you willing to take up the post?"

Liu Ji was stunned. For a moment, anger surged in his heart. He almost wanted to stand up, scold Heifu severely, and ask him why he was tormenting him like this.

But in the end, this man who was best at humiliating himself swallowed his breath, lowered his head and said:

"The Lord has an order, how dare Liu Ji disobey it, but I haven't been home for three years, can you..."

Hei Fu laughed at this time, which made Liu Ji shudder.

"Since you miss home, I can send someone to bring your family to Lintun. From then on, we can stay together forever without having to worry about traveling thousands of miles away!"

"Whether you want to go back to the Central Plains and continue to be a retainer in my house, or stay in Lintun and become a five-hundred master with a low position, but you have the final say in everything, Liu Ji, you have to think carefully!"

…

After coming out of the building where Heifu was, Liu Ji felt that his back was wet with sweat...

He finally chose to stay in Lintun, although this was tantamount to exile. Lintun was on the east coast of the peninsula, the easternmost part of the world known to the Qin people.

But Liu Ji believes that he made the right choice!

"If I had chosen to go back to the Central Plains just now..."

He muttered to himself: "Now, it's just a corpse!"

The anger and humiliation lingered in Liu Ji's heart, and even if Heifu agreed to go to Pei County to send Liu Ji's wife Lu Fei to him, it could not be filled.

But there was no other way. People had to bow to the general trend. Liu Ji didn't even bother to say goodbye to the curly-eared girl. He had to pack his bags immediately and go back to Lintun to take up his post...

No, it is no longer called Lintun. Sheriff Heifu seems to be addicted to changing his name. When he assigned Liu Ji a task, he even took the time to rename Lintun:

"Seoul...from now on, I am traveling in Seoul."

When Hei Fu was given the name, he was beaming with joy, but Liu Ji just felt confused and muttered: "What kind of bad name is this!?"
